what: A back panel (fill) over the base panel spreads from the center point as a circle (clip-path circle 0 → 72%) over .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) on hover. At the same moment the button (or its pop child if there is one) pops to 1.1x with an overshoot curve cubic-bezier(0,0,.38,2) .2s. On release the circle shrinks to the center and the size returns. Used for the event site’s white button that flips to navy, the oval ticket button, the fold button, the back-to-top button and the accordion plus icon

options.[data-fx-part=base]: Front panel (child) — the face normally visible
options.[data-fx-part=fill]: Back panel (child) — placed over the same spot as the front panel, the part covers it with absolute and inset 0. Add one more set of text and icons in the opposite color
options.[data-fx-part=pop]: Child to scale (optional) — if given, only it grows instead of the attached element (accordion row: the whole row takes the Interaction and only the icon goes 1.2×)
options.--fx-scale: Scale-up factor (via style), default 1.1 — on the original, buttons and icons 1.2, pill guide buttons 1 (no growth)
options.--fx-dur: Duration of the circle spread (via style), default .4s
options.--fx-pop-ease: Growing curve (via style), default cubic-bezier(0,0,.38,2) — a bounce that overshoots 1 and returns
options.--fx-size: Circle radius when fully spread (via style), default 72% — a value that covers even the corners of the square button
options.--fx-at: Center of the circle (via style), default 50% 50%

use: View detailsView details
note: A CSS-only part, so values come in as --fx-* variables. On devices without hover (hover: none) nothing is covered, and on keyboard focus (focus-visible) only the circle is covered. The back panel’s background·text colors are painted by the user with Skin variables
